title: Durable webhook claims so a post-restart replay cannot re-decline a lead
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the store keys on sha256(key) hex, never the composed key; case 9 added (no row contains the raw token or the provider header); the EXEMPT reason restated as 'a globally-unique delivery digest'. Shrunk the write set: new tests colocated (db/webhook-claims.test.ts + inbound-replay-restart.test.ts), no separate door-wiring commit (store + wiring are one feat commit because the door settle calls need the store). Horizon 7 days, lease = the existing 15-minute WEBHOOK_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS. settle/release never throw (they log; the lease bounds the key) so a settle failure after committed side effects cannot trigger a replay; claim throws (fail closed). Retention is the lazy sweep on the claim path (once a minute) plus an exported sweepWebhookClaims(); no boot-maintenance hook added. DDL appended as its own db.exec right after the feedback table block in ensureDb (no reflow). Tenancy commit landed first, alone, under the lock.
notes: Failure fixture is a REAL store fault (DROP TABLE webhook_claims, then a reopen restores it via boot DDL), no test seam. Restart = close and drop globalThis.__kpDb, then reopen the same KP_DB_PATH; case 7 also pins that webhook-idempotency.ts holds no `new Map`, so that simulated restart is faithful. The existing webhook-idempotency.test.ts gained the unit-db import (it now touches SQLite). tsc: 0 errors in my paths; whole-tree red only on sibling in-flight app/api/auth/login/route.ts and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree. test:perf red on 22 routes (+1/+2 modules, e.g. analyze, hire-from-need, devcase routes); none of them has webhook-claims/webhook-idempotency/edge-drain/inbound-lead in its graph (checked with walkGraph), and the routes I touched (channels/inbound 111 modules, agents/report 54) are not over, so the overage comes from siblings' uncommitted devcase/github/repo-snapshot edits. The job-ingest 402/400 line was not in this run's output. Full test:unit 9988/9988 green.
